review_candidates.description: About the Company As a System Engineer (Senior Army Engineer) within the Maintenance and Engineering Support Command (MES), you will lead teams of Army Engineers and soldiers to ensure that the Army’s platforms — from tracked systems such as the Leopard 2SG and Hunter AFV, to combat wheeled platforms like TERREX and BELREX, and sophisticated systems such as Weapon Locating Radar (WLR) and HIMARS — remain operationally ready, reliable, and sustainable throughout their life cycles. About the Role You will integrate leadership, systems engineering, and innovation to maintain the Army’s technological edge. Your work ensures every system remains safe, reliable, and adaptable through life-cycle management, mid-life upgrades, system integration, and adoption of emerging technologies. This role uniquely combines technical mastery with command leadership — offering mid-career professionals the opportunity to shape both technology and people development in national defence. Responsibilities Systems Integration & Life-Cycle Engineering Oversee the engineering stewardship and maintenance governance of all Army platforms — ensuring technical assurance, safety certification, and reliability throughout the system’s life cycle. Manage the integration of subsystems (propulsion, communications, sensors, weapon systems, and control software) across tracked and wheeled platforms. Lead mid-life upgrades, obsolescence management, and platform modernisation projects to extend operational lifespan and enhance system reliability. Apply systems-engineering principles to ensure interoperability, performance optimisation, and maintainability across the fleet. Engineering Leadership & Technical Authority Serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor for assigned fleets, responsible for diagnosing system failures, analysing data, and driving defect resolution strategies. Lead technical investigations, risk assessments, and engineering assurance processes to sustain readiness and reliability. Partner with the Defence Technology Community (DTC), DSTA, DSO, and industry partners to develop and implement engineering solutions and technology insertion plans. Champion reliability modelling, predictive analytics, and condition-based maintenance to enhance sustainment effectiveness. Innovation, Technology & Capability Development Drive innovation in maintenance and sustainment, integrating technologies such as Advanced Manufacturing, AI-driven diagnostics, Unmanned Systems, and Power & Energy solutions to enhance readiness. Develop digital engineering solutions for fleet monitoring, predictive failure analysis, and life-cycle management. Identify opportunities to leverage new technologies for reducing maintenance downtime and enhancing platform performance. Collaborate with research and industry partners to trial and adopt cutting-edge technologies aligned to the Army’s long-term sustainment roadmap. Command, Leadership & People Development As a commissioned officer, lead, command, and mentor teams of engineers and soldiers in both peacetime and operational environments. Command maintenance or support detachments during exercises, operations, or overseas deployments to deliver real-time engineering solutions. Develop and train junior officers and engineers through the Army Engineer Professional Pathway (AEPP), fostering professional growth and technical accreditation (e.g., Chartered Engineer, Technologist, or Technician). Instil values-based leadership, teamwork, and professionalism in engineering operations and sustainment culture. Operational Readiness & Sustainment Management Plan, coordinate, and oversee maintenance and recovery operations to ensure platforms are mission-ready at all times. Develop sustainment strategies that integrate supply chain planning, spares forecasting (MTBF), and obsolescence management. Oversee engineering support during exercises and deployments, ensuring operational reliability and responsiveness under all conditions. Lead forward maintenance teams, employing field-deployable solutions such as mobile workshops, recovery vehicles, and additive manufacturing capabilities. Qualifications Recognised degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Systems, or related Engineering disciplines. Proven experience (5–10+ years) in systems engineering, lifecycle management, reliability analysis, or maintenance engineering. Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to integrate technology, people, and processes. Leadership capability with experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and projects. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across operational and technical domains. Required Skills Experience in defence, aerospace, or automotive engineering industries. Familiarity with predictive maintenance systems, advanced diagnostics, and system reliability analytics. Professional accreditation (e.g., Chartered Engineer) or postgraduate qualifications in Systems or Engineering Management. Who May Apply Singaporeans Military Domain Experts Scheme (MDES) is a uniformed military scheme.

The Senior Cyber Security Engineer is responsible for leading the development and implementation of secure technology solutions that protect critical law enforcement systems, sensitive data, and operational integrity. This role embeds security into digital infrastructure and aligns cyber capabilities with policing priorities, which enables NSWPF to confidently adopt new technologies, maintain public trust, and ensure the secure and effective delivery of policing services to the community. Organisational Impact – Opportunity to shape security practices across the enterprise, reducing attack surface organisation-wide. Collaboration with architects and leadership to embed security into core business processes. Innovation & Continuous Improvement - Attending cyber security conferences and experimenting with emerging technologies. Opportunities to develop automation for security posture management. Career Growth & Visibility - Stepping stone to principal or leadership roles, with visibility to senior management. mentorship opportunities and the ability to lead security initiatives. review_candidates.title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the role Ifkafin Systems is hiring a mid-level DevOps / Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure our product teams ship on. Ifkafin builds secure software for the financial industry: web applications, iOS and Android apps, and workflow automation. We are a small, hands-on team in Nairobi. Our platform is on-premises. We run Linux servers in the office, self-host services on dedicated and VPS providers, and use Cloudflare as the edge in front of what we ship. This role sits with engineering, not in a separate ticket queue. It replaces part of a senior DevOps function. You will design, implement, and operate the platform end to end: servers, networks, pipelines, environments, security, and store releases. Success in this role looks like this: production stays up; builds move cleanly from QA to staging to production; servers are defined in code and can be rebuilt; Cloudflare, Linux, and containers are under control; incidents are visible and recoverable; developers can ship without waiting on heroics. Juniors will not be considered. Location: on-site, Nairobi office. This is not a remote-first role. Responsibilities Own on-premises Linux hosts in the Nairobi office used for production and CI, including patching, users, disks, services, and uptime. Run and maintain Proxmox, including guests, storage, snapshots, and hypervisor networking. Provision and operate self-hosted servers at dedicated and VPS providers similar to OVH, including OVHcloud, Hetzner, Scaleway, Contabo, and Leaseweb. Work with public cloud where the company uses it (GCP, Azure, AWS), with Cloudflare and self-hosting as the primary surfaces. Operate Cloudflare as the edge: DNS, SSL/TLS, proxies, WAF, tunnels, access, caching, and security features. Configure reverse proxies such as Nginx or Traefik and internal service routing. Design network access for the office and hosted servers, including firewalls, ports, VPNs, and least-privilege rules. Design, deploy, and maintain containerized workloads with Docker and Docker Compose, and use Kubernetes where it is the right fit. Debug issues across operating systems, containers, networks, and application layers. Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu for hosts, DNS, Cloudflare, and networks. Make servers repeatable with Ansible, cloud-init, or an equivalent tool. Avoid one-off, unreproducible machines. Manage secrets, environment variables, and secure configuration in a controlled system. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or an equivalent system. Promote builds through development, QA, staging, and production with clear release gates. Support deployment of web applications and of mobile and desktop binaries for Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. Improve developer tooling and automation so shipping is a standard path. Instrument uptime, metrics, logs, and resource usage across office, self-hosted, and edge environments, with alerts people can act on. Harden on-premises and hosted servers, manage TLS everywhere traffic moves, and control identity and access. Implement backups, restore tests, and recovery plans that have been rehearsed. Help run publishing pipelines for Google Play, the Apple App Store, and Windows. Qualifications Required Mid-level experience. Prior ownership of production systems, not only lab or tutorial work. Strong Linux administration, including on-premises or self-hosted servers. Strong experience with Docker and containerized workloads. Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent). Practical Cloudflare experience: DNS, TLS, proxy, and security features configured by you. Experience with Terraform or OpenTofu on real infrastructure. Experience making servers repeatable (Ansible, cloud-init, or equivalent). Experience setting up observability: logs, metrics, uptime checks, and alerts. Working knowledge of at least one public cloud (GCP, Azure, or AWS) and comfort with self-hosted or OVH-class providers. Security fundamentals: firewalls, TLS, secrets, backups that can be restored. Ability to read, debug, and ship application code, especially JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js. Ability to work on-site in Nairobi with physical servers. Preferred Proxmox in production. Kubernetes operated in a live environment. Self-hosting on OVH, Hetzner, Scaleway, or similar. End-to-end Google Play, Apple App Store, or Windows publishing. Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (Next, Vue, Nuxt, or similar). Experience in a small team or startup, including improving developer tooling. This role is not a junior position, not a ticket-driven helpdesk, and not limited to a single tool or cloud provider. How to apply Send a CV and a short note on production systems you have owned: what broke, what you changed, and how it runs today. Name on-premises or self-hosted environments, not only managed cloud logos. Ifkafin Systems · Nairobi · ifkafin.com
